reviewed_by: Codex after independent dead-worker recovery diagnosis
reason: The simulation host restart guard now accepts one exact proven-dead worker only with an operator acceptance record and verifies any resulting Core recovery. The selected process-level host restart tests cover the gate, exact owner continuity, and refusal paths.
exclusions: No Nebula UI, frontend, native app, or browser journey changes. The deployer runs only on the simulation host, so a disposable LAN Core cannot exercise its service and PostgreSQL activation path. The operator requested no local tests; selected Python tests run in CI only.
